method: Ten attempted reconnect cycles; twenty 512-byte host and gateway echoes per traffic cycle.
First ping included, no explicit ARP warmup, one active test station.
Cumulative counters sampled after disconnect or immediately before a connection/DHCP panic.
Print timing measures complete logger calls, including format, lock and transport wait. Summary output and direct vendor printf are excluded.
TX resume is latest success interrupt signal to task consumption; time before ISR entry is not measured.
RX age is wrapping MAC counter minus raw receive timestamp at driver delivery, including scan/connection traffic.
Histograms are diagnostic snapshots of separate atomics, not a transactional or permanent uptime counter.
Info still emits packet metadata at INFO. Quiet additionally filters examples::packet_trace.
The first two builds use the default 80-MHz CPU from esp-hal source. Later builds also log runtime CPU frequency.
All images retain the same clocks, queue/parser corrections, PHY tracking cadence and network timeouts except the explicit CPU comparison.
Final source formatting is separate from the exact hardware image hashes and saved build-source snapshots.
